answer: Census bond: each identity posts a 70-credit bond and files a return for its timber. Auditors sample one in twenty mills, checking the smoke plume against it; a return whose delta from the last census tops 20% with no receipts gets a full re-weigh. A forged return burns the bond and bans the key 20 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 2,539,500, first 42 rising 5 each, plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. An honest mill pays 42 once and keeps its share.
